question: Who was the first woman judge to be appointed in the Supreme Court of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fatima Beevi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fatima Beevi** was the first woman judge to be appointed to the Supreme Court of India.
 
• She was appointed on **6 October 1989**.
 
• Her appointment marked a significant milestone in the history of the Indian judiciary.
 
• Fatima Beevi's appointment paved the way for greater representation of women in the higher judiciary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fatima Beevi** was born on 30 April 1927 in Pathanamthitta, Kerala.
 
• She began her career in the judicial service in Kerala and rose through the ranks due to her dedication and competence.
 
• Before her appointment to the Supreme Court, she served as a judge in the Kerala High Court.
 
• After her retirement, she also served as the Governor of Tamil Nadu from 1997 to 2001.
 
• Her contributions have inspired many women to pursue careers in the judiciary and other fields of public service.
